post.caption:
Whales evolved from a deer-sized land animal roughly 50 million years ago, through Pakicetus, Ambulocetus, Rodhocetus and Basilosaurus. They still carry vestigial hip bones floating inside the body and five finger bones inside each fin. And they still cannot breathe underwater, because the land origin never fully left.
